# tmplforge

Go templates, forged at the terminal or in the browser.

![ci](https://github.com/CoolGitOrg/tmplforge/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)

## Install

```sh
go install github.com/CoolGitOrg/tmplforge/cmd/tmplforge@latest
tmplforge version
```

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `sh` | line-command TUI (ed/sam style) |
| `serve` | HTML GUI \| htmx |
| `render` | one-shot render |
